tools.name: get_contract_spec
tools.description:
How to write a realtime contract: the template, the dictated response
envelope, the rules, two worked samples, the lifecycle, and your agent's own
facts (feed type, id column, bound fields, credential).

tools.name: get_canonical_schema
tools.description:
The full feed schema for your agent's feed type. Each field carries its type,
tier and description, plus is_id (the id column, always the first field of a
contract) and bound_to_this_agent (outputs only: at least one of them must be in
fields, and none may be a {column} input).

tools.name: submit_contract
tools.description:
Submit a contract document in its final form (see get_contract_spec).

The platform validates it, gates it against your agent, and verifies it with one
live call built from sample_request. Every submit creates a new contract:
verified with the next version number when all three pass, failed with no
version otherwise. The response says which step failed and how to fix it; fix
the document and submit again. When the response says verified, call
activate_contract with that version.

Args:
    contract: the contract document.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description:
Your agent's verified contract versions, oldest first, and which one is
active. Failed and retired versions are never listed.

tools.name: activate_contract
tools.description:
Make one verified version the live contract. The gates and the live
verification call run again first, so a version that no longer matches the
agent or the API is refused with the evidence and nothing changes. On a
published composition, a version that sends a {column} input the composition
does not map is refused. The previously active version becomes retired.

Args:
    version: a version number from list_contracts.
    test_user_token: for a user-credential contract only, a dummy token for the
        re-verification call. Never stored.
